check_box.name: hide_own_check
check_box.label: Hide my own animations
check_box.tool_tip: Hide the animations your avatar plays itself (gestures, your animation overrider, the standard ones); show only what objects play on you

scroll_list.columns.name: priority
scroll_list.columns.label: Prio
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: Animation priority, known once the animation has loaded

view_border.name: animation_preview
view_border.tool_tip: The selected animation on a stand-in avatar. Drag to turn and zoom, Ctrl+drag to orbit, Ctrl+Shift+drag to pan, scroll to zoom.

button.name: try_btn
button.label: Try on me
button.tool_tip: Play the selected animation on your own avatar; only you see it. Press again, or pick another one, to stop.

button.name: stop_btn
button.label: Stop
button.tool_tip: Stop the selected animation(s) on your avatar, for everyone

button.name: revoke_btn
button.label: Stop and revoke
button.tool_tip: Stop the selected animation(s) and take back the permission to animate you from the object that played them

button.name: copy_uuid_btn
button.label: Copy UUID
button.tool_tip: Copy the animation asset ID(s) to the clipboard

button.name: block_btn
button.label: Block animation
button.tool_tip: Never play the selected animation(s) on your avatar, no matter what starts them
